Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select print_id, forms_type, '0'
 into :printer_id, :display_forms_type , :echo_count
 from rpt_report_names
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
 if :report_status = 'C'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'ompleted';
 elsif :report_status = 'S'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'ubmitted';
 elsif :report_status = 'E'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'xecuting';
 else
 :dis_report_status := 'Unknown';
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 filename VARCHAR2(50) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
begin
 enter;
 check_package_failure;
--
 if :action not in ('R','D','P','L')
 then
 message('Err: Invalid action entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 if :rpt_parm.rowid is null
 then
 message ('Err: No report selected');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 if :action != 'D'
 then
 if :report_status != 'C'
 then
 message('Err: Report not in completed status');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 filename := '$REPOUTPUT/' || :report_name ||
 '_' || :parm_id || '_' || :rpt_parm.user_name ||'.r';
 --
 if :action = 'R'
 then
 command := get_review_command (filename ,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type );
 elsif :action = 'D'
 then
 command := get_delete_command (filename);
 elsif :action = 'P'
 then
 command := get_print_command (filename,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type,
 :rpt_parm.printer_id ,
 :ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id );
 elsif :action = 'L'
 then
 command := get_locprint_command (filename,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type );
 end if;
 host_command (command );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DELETE_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_delete_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
begin
 return ( '/bin/rm -f ' ||' '|| filename );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCPRINT_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_locprint_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 , form_type in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
begin
 return ( 'locprint.sh'||' '|| filename||' '|| form_type);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRINT_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_print_command ( filename in VARCHAR2,
 form_type in VARCHAR2,
 printer_id in VARCHAR2,
 user_printer_id in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
begin
 select code_info || ' ' ||
 decode(printer_id,NULL,
 decode(user_printer_id,NULL,NULL,'-d'||user_printer_id),
 '-d'||printer_id) || ' ' ||
 filename
 into command
 from rpt_master_codes
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and code_type = 'FORM'
 and code = form_type;
 return ( command);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_REVIEW_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_review_command ( filename in VARCHAR2 , form_type in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
begin
 return ( 'rmreview.sh '||' '|| filename ||' '|| form_type );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: HOST_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure host_command ( command in VARCHAR2 ) is
 record_no number(4);
begin
 if :ACTION = 'D'
 then
 HOST(COMMAND,NO_SCREEN);
 else
 HOST(COMMAND);
 if form_failure
 then
 message('Err: The report action failed.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
 if :action = 'D'
 then
 record_no := :system.cursor_record;
 :submit_date := NULL ;
 :report_status := NULL;
 commit;
 execute_query;
 go_record(record_no);
 end if;
 :action := NULL ;
 GO_ITEM ('action');
end;
